title: Frequent Confirmers
scenario: Find the 'user_id' of all users who have requested more than 2 confirmation messages in total. Return the result table as 'user_id'.
tableSchema: signups (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME), confirmations (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME, action VARCHAR)
hint: Group the confirmations table by user_id and count requests using HAVING.
correctQuery: SELECT user_id FROM confirmations GROUP BY user_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE confirmations (user_id INT, time_stamp DATETIME, action VARCHAR); INSERT INTO confirmations VALUES (7, '2021-06-12 11:57:29', 'confirmed'), (7, '2021-06-13 12:58:28', 'confirmed'), (7, '2021-06-14 13:59:27', 'confirmed'), (3, '2021-01-06 03:30:46', 'timeout');
